name: Mis Kebap & Döner
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover Authentic Turkish Flavors in Innsbruck**

Welcome to **Mis Kebap & Döner**, your go-to spot in **Innsbruck** for delicious, freshly prepared Turkish cuisine. Whether you're craving a juicy **Döner Kebap**, a flavorful **Lahmacun**, or a hearty **Adana Kebap**, we’ve got you covered.

Our **Kebap** is made with premium cuts of meat, slow-roasted to perfection, and served with your choice of fresh vegetables, garlic sauce, and a side of crispy **Pommes**. For a lighter option, try our **Gemüse Kebap**—a vegetarian delight packed with grilled veggies and aromatic spices.

Don’t miss our **Döner Platte**, a generous serving of shredded meat piled high on warm flatbread, topped with tangy **Tzatziki**, pickles, and onions. Pair it with a cold **Ayran** or a refreshing **Fanta** for the full experience.

We also serve classic **Kebap** sides like **Patates** (crispy fries), **Salat** (fresh mixed greens), and **Kebap Sauce**—spicy, smoky, and irresistible.

**Mis Kebap & Döner** is more than just food—it’s a taste of **Anatolia** right in the heart of **Tirol**. Stop by for a quick bite or join us for a cozy meal with friends. Your taste buds will thank you!
